sources.provider: Indiana statewide imagery served through Purdue GIS image service
sources.use: Sampled each of 192 existing roof-slab top-face centroids after transformation to the registered local map frame; changed appearance only.
sources.limits: Color sampling is a visual classification, not roof-material identification. Orthophoto shadows and adjacent objects can influence sample color. It does not prove the underlying slab geometry or actual roof substrate.

sources.use: Read-only spatial context used to evaluate how much each slab footprint falls outside the official building footprint.
sources.limits: The GIS footprint is not a roof-plan outline; overhangs and canopies may extend beyond it. It is a mismatch indicator, not a clipping boundary.

registration: Reuses the existing local frame and orthophoto extent transform documented in map_lidar_r5.py and overlay_roof_zones_r9.py. No camera registration, geometry fit, or placement adjustment was added.
